description: Mostly an opening detector: fires right after the game's first stone lands in column 5 (strongest), 3 or 4, not 0-2 or 6; also at ply 2-3 when the newest stone is the first in column 5 and columns 0, 4, 6 are empty. Later it fires when the last stone nearly fills column 4 (5th or 6th stone there, column 4 a large share of all stones). Some diffuse late-game firing is unexplained.
effect: none measurable (steering to max or zero changes no move probability by even 0.01)
notes: Layer-0 unit: last-move column x bag of earlier stones (order-insensitive, stack height matters). Opening rule alone: F1 0.60 at precision 1.0. Adding ply 2-3 col-5 and col-4-top rules: best F1 0.643 (P .72, R .58, AUROC .79). Remaining ~40% of firing is late-game, diffuse (e.g. cols 2-3 full and col 4 empty with various last moves); loose rules for it collapsed precision. Simulation share ~0 because the unit has no measurable steering effect. Could not beat dev max 1.554 (= opening 5).
